- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **design history / theory / criticism contribution** — humanities-oriented.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Empirical / engineering design redirected to Design Studies.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Empirical / engineering design research (consider Design Studies)
- Pure HCI research
- AI use without disclosure per MIT Press policy

### Soft Tax

Low for design history / theory tradition authors.

### Best Suited For

- Design history scholarship
- Design theory / criticism essays
- Design and society analyses
- Humanities-oriented design discourse

### Not Recommended For

- Empirical design research (consider Design Studies)
- Pure HCI (consider TOCHI)

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Design Studies](./design-studies.md) | Empirical design peer; Elsevier |
| 2 | [Journal of Design History](../hci/journal-of-design-history.md) | OUP design history peer |
| 3 | [AI & Society](./ai-and-society.md) | If design + AI/STS focus |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from Design Studies as "too humanities / not empirical," Design Issues is the MIT Press home.
